detail.longDescription: There's an intersection by my house where seven roads converge into one chaotic circle, all without the guidance of a single traffic light. It's a test of survival skills disguised as traffic engineering, where your only option is to white-knuckle your way through and hope you make it out unscathed. Transferring files from Dropbox to Google Drive is a lot like that traffic circle.
